strategies.name: Elo model edge
strategies.rule: Bet the player whose Elo model chance × DraftKings odds − 1 is at least 5%.

strategies.name: DraftKings beats Pinnacle
strategies.rule: Bet the player whose DraftKings odds × Pinnacle's fair chance − 1 is at least 1% (line shopping).

strategies.name: Every underdog (control)
strategies.rule: Bet the longer DraftKings price in every match. Expect to lose about DraftKings' margin.
